p.src: 1  Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

en: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.
u.src: 1  Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

p.src: 2  The LORD also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.

ja: はユダをも訴える。 ヤコブをその
en: The LORD also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.
u.src: 2  The LORD also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.

p.src: 3  In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.

ja: のかかとをつかみ、 成人すると
en: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.
u.src: 3  In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.

p.src: 4  Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us— 5  even the LORD, the God of Armies. The LORD is his name of renown!

ja: まことに、御使いと格闘して勝った。 彼は泣いて、御使いに願い求めた。 彼はベテルで神に出会い、 そこで神は私たちに語られた――
zh: 與天使較力，並且得勝， 哭泣懇求， 在伯特利遇見耶和華。 耶和華－萬軍之上帝在那裏曉諭我們以色列人； 耶和華是他可記念的名。
en: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us—
even the LORD, the God of Armies. The LORD is his name of renown!
u.src: 4  Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us— 5  even the LORD, the God of Armies. The LORD is his name of renown!

p.src: 6  Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.

ja: り、 絶えずあなたの
en: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.
u.src: 6  Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.

p.src: 7  A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.

en: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
u.src: 7  A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.

p.src: 8  Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”

ja: は富んだ。 私は自分のために
た。 この富のどこを探しても、 罪に問われる
en: Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”
u.src: 8  Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”

p.src: 9  “But I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

p.src: 10  I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.

ja: して、 たとえを語った。
en: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.
u.src: 10  I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.

p.src: 11  If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.

をいけにえにする。 その

u.src: 11  If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.

p.src: 12  Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.

ja: げた。 イスラエルは
en: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.
u.src: 12  Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.

によってイスラエルを
en: By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
u.src: 13  By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.

p.src: 14  Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt.

ja: らせた。 それゆえ、その
